draft.title: Entrepreneurship and innovation
card: a person who sees an opportunity, such as a customer need no one is meeting, and starts a business to meet it.
Starting a business is a risk. The entrepreneur may lose the money and time they put in if it fails. Working for someone else's business does not carry this risk.
a new or better product, or a new or better way of working, such as a faster process. It does not need to be a world first: a business that adopts a better method is innovating.
Innovation drives competition. When one business innovates, its rivals must improve their own products or methods, or lose customers.
draft.remember: Entrepreneurs take the risk of starting a business. Innovation keeps rivals competing.

a.q: Which person is acting as an entrepreneur?
opts: Priya uses her savings to start a mobile dog-wash van
Ahmed takes a paid job at a newly opened start-up
Jo buys a small share in a large mining company
Ben becomes a regular customer at a new local bakery
a.why: Priya has spotted an opportunity and risks her own savings to start a business. Ahmed works at a new business, but he did not start it and earns a wage whether or not it succeeds.
a.clue: Who started the business and carries the risk if it fails?

b.q: A café in Ballarat starts taking orders through an app, which cuts waiting times. Within months, two rival cafés nearby do the same. Which statement is correct?
opts: It is an innovation, and it pushed rivals to improve
It is not an innovation, as ordering apps already exist
It is an innovation, but it reduced competition
It is not an innovation, as the café sells no new product
b.why: A better way of working counts as innovation, even if other businesses already use it. The rivals copied it to keep their customers, which shows innovation driving competition. The app being used elsewhere does not matter, as innovation does not need to be a world first.
b.clue: Does an innovation have to be a new product or a world first?

a.best: Priya uses her savings to start a mobile dog-wash van

b.best: It is an innovation, and it pushed rivals to improve
